topic.title: Timing of solution sharing after the deadline

messages.content:
This may be a bit early to ask, but I'd like to clarify when we are allowed to share our solutions after the competition ends.

In typical competitions, solution write-ups start appearing right after the submission deadline. However, this competition is a bit unique — final rankings take time to be determined, and there is also the strategy track to consider.

To be clear, I understand there are restrictions on what can be shared (e.g., code sharing rules and Pokémon Elements), and I intend to fully comply with them. My question is purely about the timing.

Personally, I'd love to share and discuss approaches while everything is still fresh, but I can also see reasonable arguments for waiting until all results are finalized. Any guidance or comments would be appreciated. Thanks!
